newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse ends session higher.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse ends session higher.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange ended its two-hour session on Monday up 0.10 percent, resuming its upward trend after a three-week stagnation, brokers said.
The all-share index closed at 434.21 points, up from 433.76 points on the previous session.
The rise was mainly due to gains registered by blue chip ONA Group, an analyst at Casablanca Finance Intermediation said.
ONA, Morocco's largest private group which holds stakes in more than 100 firms, rose five dirhams to close at 490 dirhams.

"But it should be noted that the index did not react to the flotation of the private credit company CREDOR on the stock exchange," the analyst said. CREDOR, a private family firm, floated 240,000 shares worth 92.4 million dirhams. The closing date for public subscription was set for December 13, officials said. A stake of 10 percent of the stock was reserved for national and foreign institutional investors. The stock was offered for 385 dirhams per share. The firm will be listed on the bourse next week, a bourse official said. Consumer credit firm Eqdom gained 21 dirhams to close at 1,060 dirhams. Morocco's steel mill giant SONASID rose one dirham to 326 dirhams. Societe Nationale d'Investissement, the country's second largest private conglomerate, remained stable at 535 dirhams after paying a 10 dirhams dividend to shareholders on
Traded volume on the official market rose to 30.6 million dirhams from 18.4 million on Friday.
